instructions.name: _dummy
docs: To force IDL generation for some struct for easier TS decoding later

instructions.name: claim_fee
docs: Claim all pending stake token and quote token fees to the user. The program is deprecated, so the stake token fee is no longer restaked.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Withdraw an existing unstake request. The program is deprecated, so the unstake lock duration is not enforced.

instructions.name: withdraw_stake
docs: Withdraw all staked tokens directly from the stake escrow, without an unstake request and lock duration.
